title: RIS AI&Data DMS (Data Managed Services) SA - L7
description:
**Job Description Overview:**  

Accenture's Data \& AI practice empowers global enterprises to modernize data foundations, scale generative and agentic AI, and achieve measurable business reinvention. Its end\-to\-end capabilities span data platform modernization, cloud migration of legacy data estates, development of cutting\-edge AI and Gen AI solutions, and production support of AI \& Data applications.
  
  

**You Are:** \[DMS \- Data Managed Services SA]
  
  

As a Data Managed Services Presales Solution Architect, you will lead the end\-to\-end solution blueprint and roadmap, acting as the bridge between client vision and technology execution. You will be instrumental in translating business problems into technology solutions and having stakeholder alignment throughout the deal lifecycle. In this role, you’ll gain experience in designing Data \& AI application maintenance and support solutions, working across global delivery and sales teams. You will work cross clouds, cross industry cross geography giving depth and breadth of exposure. You’ll also deepen your expertise in emerging technologies like Databricks, Snowflake, Gen AI, Agents —preparing you for the future.
  
  

**The Work:**  

Understand RFP/RFIs and translate the business needs into technical architecture (data engineering, data visualization, AI, Gen AI).
  
  

Understand end\-to\-end application architectures diagrams (data ingestion to data consumption to AI/ML).
  
  

Map technology components (e.g. Informatica, Power BI, PySpark, Azure ML, Azure Foundry, GCP BigQuery, AWS Glue, Snowflake, Databricks etc.) with business use cases.
  
  

Prepare detailed ADM effort estimates for application maintenance and enhancements and get them validated with AI \& Data capability SMEs.
  
  

Design optimal staffing models based on onshore/offshore/nearshore mix and pyramid structure.
  
  

Build solution plan power point decks for use in sales and delivery alignment.
  
  

Engage in solution and delivery reviews with leadership across geographies.
  
  

Act as the strategic link between sales and delivery teams.
  
  

Contribute to client\-facing proposals, SOWs, and contracting documents.
  
  

Present and defend your solution in internal and external forums.
  
  

Seamlessly transition the solution to the delivery team post\-deal closure.
  
  

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 10% to 25% depending on business need and client requirements.
  
  

**Here’s What You Need:**  

**Must Have:** Strong Data engineering or Business intelligence or AI/Gen AI experience in application maintenance projects
  
  

Working knowledge of cloud ecosystems – Azure or AWS, or Google Cloud.
  
  

Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Pivot tables, filters, vlookup etc.).
  
  

Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills.
  
  

Experience working in cross\-functional and global environments.
  
  

**Experience:** Minimum 12 years of relevant IT industry experience in AI \& Data delivery or Presales
  
  

**Location:** Any city having Accenture office.
  
  

**Education:** 15 years of full\-time education required.
  
  

**Bonus Points If you have:**  

Good PowerPoint skills for leadership and client storytelling.
  
  

External client\-facing experience

title: Large Language Model Architect
description:
**Project Role :** Large Language Model Architect  

**Project Role Description :** Architect large language models (LLM) that can process and generate natural language. Design neural network parameters, trained on large quantities of unlabeled text data.
  

**Must have skills :** Large Language Models (LLMs)  

**Good to have skills :** Microsoft Azure Data Services  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

AI Powered Tech Talent  

Role Summary / Description  

Engineer role in AI LLM Technology Architecture for Level 8/9\. Hands\-on engineering role focused on designing, building, integrating, testing and operationalizing enterprise\-grade LLM, GenAI and agentic AI components across active client engagements.  

Own platform\-specific engineering on Azure, translating high\-level architecture into working, production\-quality components for LLM\-driven applications, RAG pipelines, multi\-agent workflows and AI platform integrations.  

Bring practical industry experience in banking, insurance, healthcare, public sector, retail or energy to identify domain data, process constraints, controls and adoption risks while designing GenAI solutions that are safe, scalable and relevant.  

Operate as a hands\-on Level 9 technical lead or Level 8 engineering lead, contributing code, design decisions, reusable patterns and engineering documentation.  

  

Key Responsibilities  

Design and build LLM application components including prompts, tools, agents, orchestration flows, memory/context handling, retrieval pipelines and evaluation harnesses.  

Create Foundry\-based agents with enterprise tools, knowledge and memory integrate Azure AI Search for RAG implement secure API/tool calls through API Management, Logic Apps and Functions instrument traces, evaluations, guardrails and policy controls for production agents.  

Implement data ingestion, parsing, chunking, enrichment, embeddings, vector search and retrieval workflows for structured and unstructured enterprise content.  

Engineer safety and control components including PII detection/redaction, prompt\-injection defenses, content filters, guardrails, authentication, authorization, lineage and audit logging.  

Collaborate with architects, data engineers, product owners and security stakeholders to convert solution designs into tested, observable and maintainable software components.  

Maintain technical artifacts such as component designs, integration specifications, deployment runbooks, evaluation results and reusable engineering patterns.  

  

Required Qualifications  

Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, Information Technology or a related engineering discipline.  

Level 9: typically 5\+ years of software/data/AI engineering experience, including 2\+ years in cloud\-native engineering and 1\+ year in GenAI, LLM, NLP or agentic AI delivery.  

Level 8: typically 7\+ years of software/data/AI engineering experience, including 3\+ years in cloud\-native architecture/engineering and 1–2\+ years in GenAI, LLM, NLP or agentic AI delivery.  

Hands\-on coding experience in Python and strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, testing, observability and secure SDLC practices.  

Experience delivering AI/ML or data products in at least one industry domain such as banking, insurance, healthcare, public sector, retail or energy.  

  

Required Skills/ Experience  

Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI Foundry, Foundry Agent Service, Azure OpenAI models, Azure AI Search, Prompt Flow, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Event Grid, Microsoft Fabric, Entra ID, Key Vault, Azure Monitor and Application Insights.  

Strong understanding of LLM application architecture patterns including RAG, function/tool calling, agent orchestration, model invocation, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases and evaluation metrics.  

Ability to implement traditional ML and GenAI components across ingestion, feature/data preparation, model integration, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.  

Practical knowledge of security, privacy, governance, performance, scalability, reliability and cost controls for production AI systems.  

Experience with Git\-based development, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code and agile delivery in client\-facing environments.  

  

Good to Have Skills  

Azure AI Engineer, Azure Solutions Architect or Azure Developer certification experience with Microsoft Fabric, Semantic Kernel, Prompt Flow, private networking, Defender for Cloud and enterprise Responsible AI governance.  

Exposure to open\-source frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Haystack, MLflow, FastAPI, Docker and Kubernetes.  

Experience with Responsible AI, model risk management, synthetic data generation, human\-in\-the\-loop review, A/B testing and GenAI cost optimization.


  

15 years full time education

title: Senior IT Pillar Specialist
description:
**Job Overview:**

The Full Stack Developer position provides technical expertise in building modern solutions using AI\-assisted tools responsibly to accelerate discovery, prototyping, development, testing, and documentation without compromising architecture, security, code quality, or accountability. The role expects reliable delivery of business outcomes with predictable quality, security, and operational readiness by reducing lead time from concept to production through automation, reusable patterns, and effective AI\-assisted engineering. Our ingenuity fuels daily life. * Design and implement secure REST APIs using Microservices architecture with .NET / ASP.NET Core, C\#, Python, and FastAPI or Flask
* Engineer solutions using appropriate platform services, managed identities, secrets management, monitoring, and cost\-conscious design. Implement secure authentication, authorization, and data protection mechanisms

AI\-Assisted Debugging \& Refactoring to accelerate development tasks while retaining full ownership of design and code decisions. Create effective prompts and context patterns for code generation, refactoring, test creation, debugging, documentation, and technical discovery

**Essential Qualifications and Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related field

* Strong expertise in .NET / ASP.NET Core, C\#, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS and responsive design
* Proficiency in Python and at least one modern API framework such as FastAPI or Flask
* Demonstrated experience designing REST APIs, microservices, integration layers, and distributed application components

* Solid understanding of automated testing, Git workflows, CI/CD, Docker, application security, performance tuning, and observability
* Core exposure to GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Prompt Engineering, AI\-Based Code Generation
* Exposure to ITIL Principles and Change management process

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

* Own architecture decisions for modularity, API contracts, identity, authorization, data access, resilience, performance and observability.

* 3\+ years as a Development Lead, Technical Lead or comparable engineering leader.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on Angular and TypeScript experience.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on Java and Spring Boot experience.
* 2\+ years of practical Python development for APIs, services, integrations, automation or data processing.
* Demonstrated leadership of approximately five or more engineers through direct or matrix accountability.
* Strong experience with cloud platforms, CI/CD, microservices, REST APIs, databases and code\-review practices.
* Proven ownership of architecture decisions, secure delivery, production support and root\-cause resolution.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* 10\+ years of enterprise software development and 3\+ years of technical\-leadership experience.
* 5\+ years of Angular experience covering TypeScript, component architecture, routing, forms, responsive design, state management, performance and testing.
* 5\+ years of Java and Spring Boot experience covering REST APIs, dependency injection, persistence, exception handling and service design.
* 2\+ years of Python experience for APIs, services, integration, automation or data\-processing use cases.
* Experience leading or mentoring a team of approximately five or more developers.
* Strong knowledge of secure API and microservices design, validation, versioning, failure handling and distributed\-system fundamentals.
* Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, data modeling and transaction management.
* Experience with Azure, AWS or OCI; Git workflows; CI/CD; automated deployment; and environment\-based configuration.
* Experience with unit, integration and end\-to\-end testing, quality gates, code scanning and security scanning.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot production issues across browser, API, application, database and integration layers.
* Strong estimation, planning, risk\-management, stakeholder and technical\-communication skills.
* Docker and Kubernetes or equivalent managed container platforms.
* Event\-driven architecture and messaging technologies such as Kafka.
* Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask or Django; JPA or Hibernate for Java persistence.
* OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, enterprise identity providers and role\-based access control.
* Web accessibility, internationalization, caching, content delivery and front\-end performance optimization.
* Application performance monitoring, centralized logging and distributed tracing.
* DevSecOps, threat modeling, OWASP awareness, software\-composition analysis and secrets management.
* Legacy modernization, monolith decomposition and reduction of unnecessary technology complexity.
* Remain hands\-on enough to review critical code, prototype approaches and lead difficult troubleshooting without becoming the team bottleneck.
* Create clear ownership across front\-end, back\-end, integration, testing and operational\-readiness work.
* Select technology based on business fit, supportability, security and total lifecycle cost.
* Protect quality during schedule pressure through explicit, risk\-based trade\-offs.
* Develop successors and broaden knowledge so critical applications are not dependent on one engineer.
* Give timely, respectful and actionable feedback that improves delivery and capability.

title: Manager, Hotel Partner Solutions
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


### **Introduction to the Team**

Travel Partnerships and Advertising helps partners, including hotels, airlines, destination marketing organizations, and more, deliver excellent traveler and B2B experiences. We create growth for our partners and the Expedia Group marketplace through competitive supply, travel media, and affiliate solutions.


As Manager—Hotel Partner Solutions, you will lead a team of analysts and technical professionals who deliver solutions supporting hotel partners and business priorities. You will connect technology decisions to partner needs, guide multi\-quarter projects, and create an environment that supports collaboration, development, and meaningful outcomes.


### **Key Responsibilities**

**In this role, you will:**

* Provide direction, coaching, feedback, and technical guidance to a team of analysts and individual contributors.
* Establish team goals, clarify roles and accountabilities, and connect daily work to business priorities.
* Lead delivery across multiple well\-defined, multi\-quarter projects.
* Serve as a technical lead for a defined domain and select appropriate technologies for business and partner needs.
* Partner with Product teams to develop and deliver roadmaps.
* Oversee operational support activities, service performance, response trends, and adherence to established procedures.
* Identify opportunities to improve technology, processes, efficiency, and productivity.
* Plan team capacity and allocate financial, material, and technical resources responsibly.
* Build trusted relationships with hotel partners and internal stakeholders by understanding needs and communicating practical solutions.
* Hire, onboard, recognize, and develop team members while supporting professional growth.
* Monitor key performance indicators, communicate team status, and surface risks, dependencies, and opportunities for simplification.
* Contribute to product reviews, communities of practice, and the product development lifecycle from idea through launch and ongoing improvement.

### **Experience and Qualifications**

Required


* 5\+ years of related experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 3\+ years of related experience with a master’s degree.
* 1–3 years of people leadership experience, including coaching, feedback, performance support, and workload planning.
* Experience leading at least three multi\-quarter projects as a technical lead or equivalent individual contributor.
* Experience with multiple technology implementations and selecting technologies for specific business or partner needs.
* Bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, or equivalent related professional experience; technical degree preferred, including Information Technology, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, or a related technical field.
* Proficient communication skills and the ability to connect technical concepts with business priorities.

Preferred


* Experience supporting hotel, hospitality, travel, or partner\-facing technology solutions.
* Experience partnering with Product teams on roadmaps and product development.
* Experience supporting technology operations or service management.
Experience identifying process improvements and using metrics to evaluate outcomes.  
*

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

title: Global IT Configuration Engineer Manager
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


As a Global IT Configuration Engineer Manager on BCG’s IT HR Systems Group, you will serve as a hands\-on configuration expert across Workday, with deep focus on Advanced Compensation—designing, building, and maintaining salary, bonus, eligibility rules, and cycle frameworks—while also supporting configuration across Core HCM, Security, and other modules as needed to ensure cohesive, scalable system design aligned with business strategy. You will work with Global Comp Stakeholders and Product Team to translate BCG’s compensation strategy into scalable Workday solutions, combining technical configuration and functional expertise to ensure accurate execution of compensation cycles, data integrity, and continuous platform improvement

  

What You'll Bring

* Certification, such as Workday Pro \- Advanced Compensation, is strongly preferred.
* Prior Consulting experience as a Workday Comp Lead or an architect role on end\-to\-end implementation projects is strongly preferred
* Prior experience with large, global companies with complex enterprise\-scale comp implementations in Workday is strongly preferred
* Experience developing and executing comprehensive test plans to ensure high quality before deployment is preferred
* Familiarity with Workday Docs and BIRT to build templates and control dynamic field visibility, and with Workday Security Configuration, is preferred
* Technical troubleshooting skills, including debugging and analysis of performance issues, are preferred
* Skilled in stakeholder management, offering training and support to end\-users during annual compensation cycles while delivering exceptional customer service year\-round for L3 support items is preferred

  

Who You'll Work With


The Global IT Configuration Engineer Manager will join a team of:

* Other members of the HR IT team, including the Workday Delivery Team, the Comp squad, and other squads under the People Portfolio
* Global Comp stakeholders to translate business strategies into scalable, system\-wide solutions
* QA Teams for testing on specific enhancements and software releases

  

Additional info

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

  

Plan and Execute Comp Configuration: Design and build intricate variable pay, merit, bonus, allowances, including compensation review statements, and the overall coordination of events within Workday.  

Cycle Management: Own the end\-to\-end execution of Annual Salary Reviews, mass operation management, and merit grid setups.  

Business Processes: Configure Business Process Frameworks (BPF), condition rules, validations, and complex calculated fields.  

Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Product Team and HR/Compensation leaders to translate business strategies into scalable, system\-wide solutions  

Testing: Perform Testing, validate self and peer configurations, and troubleshoot system defects during Workday releases.  

Documentation: Create clear and comprehensive specification documents for application modifications and new functionality additions, for Workday  

Data Integrity \& Audits: Ensure the accuracy of compensation data and maintain internal compliance and audit processes.  

Workday Technology: Stay abreast of functional \& development tools, including Workday AI offerings, trends and practices, and act as an evangelist for items that should be considered for future initiatives

 *At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*  

  

*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*  

  

*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork*

title: Team Leader - Operations
description:
The **Role**

This is not a routine policy\-processing or supervisory role.

The Operations Lead will own the complete operational lifecycle across policy issuance,

endorsements, cancellations, SLA/TAT, dealer support, insurer coordination, operational

escalations, team productivity and technology\-enabled process automation.

The person will lead the L2 Operations function and work closely with Sales, Finance, Product

and Technology teams to ensure that operational issues do not become business bottlenecks.

The ideal candidate is a hands\-on operator, problem solver and process owner who can

manage people, processes, partners and technology together.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Motor Insurance Operations

Own day\-to\-day execution and quality of:

**New Motor Policy Issuance**

**Renewals**

**Endorsements**

**Cancellations**

**Policy corrections**

**Break\-in cases**

**Inspection coordination**

**Documentation and verification**

**Premium / coverage / add\-on validation**

**Policy servicing and related operational requests**

Ensure accuracy, compliance, productivity and SLA adherence across the complete process.

2\. SLA \& Operations Management

Own operational SLA/TAT from case initiation to closure.

Monitor real\-time operational performance and pending cases.

Identify SLA risks and intervene before they become escalations.

Track SLA performance across insurers, portals, dealers, regions and business channels.

Establish structured reason, category and sub\-category classification for operational

exceptions.

Conduct RCA for SLA breaches and recurring operational issues.

Drive corrective and preventive actions.

Maintain operational dashboards and performance reviews.

Ensure consistent SLA adherence across the L2 function.

The expectation is to prevent SLA breaches—not simply report them.

3\. Technology\-Enabled Operations \& Automation

Lead the evolution of a technology\-enabled insurance operations model.

Drive adoption and optimization of AI/ML\-enabled and intelligent workflow solutions

across policy issuance and servicing.

Identify repetitive, high\-volume and error\-prone processes for automation.

Work with Product \& Technology teams to convert operational requirements into

scalable solutions.

Monitor automation effectiveness, processing accuracy and operational throughput.

Analyse exceptions and recurring failure patterns and drive resolution.

Continuously reduce manual dependency and operational turnaround time.

Ensure appropriate operational fallback processes for technology or system exceptions.

The goal: faster processing, higher accuracy, lower operational dependency and scalable

growth.

4\. Insurer, Aggregator \& Portal Management

Act as the operational SPOC for insurers, aggregators and external operational partners.

Coordinate with insurers and aggregators for issuance, servicing and escalation matters.

Manage insurer/portal\-related operational issues.

Maintain appropriate redundancy and fallback processes for critical operational

dependencies.

Track insurer\-wise operational performance and SLA.

Ensure timely escalation and closure of unresolved issues.

Work with Technology/Product teams to address recurring portal/process issues.

5\. Dealer \& Sales Operations Support

Own Operations as a focal point for Sales and Dealer support.

Resolve dealer operational queries and escalations.

Support Sales on issuance, endorsement, cancellation and servicing requirements.

Define and maintain Sales–Operations escalation processes and response SLAs.

Ensure dealer issues are tracked through closure.

Identify recurring dealer issues and eliminate root causes.

Work closely with Sales to ensure operational readiness for business growth.

6\. L2 Team Leadership \& Productivity

Lead the L2 Operations team and own its performance.

Allocate workload based on volume and priority.

Set individual and team productivity expectations.

Monitor workload, capacity, productivity and quality.

Conduct daily/weekly operational reviews.

Coach and develop team members.

Identify performance gaps and initiate corrective actions/PIPs where required.

Manage shift planning, leave and operational coverage.

Build a high\-accountability and high\-productivity culture.

7\. Wallet, Recharge \& Operational Reconciliation

Coordinate and own operational resolution for:

Dealer wallet/recharge issues

Recharge failures

Balance discrepancies

Policy\-to\-wallet reconciliation

Dealer payment\-related operational queries

Coordination with Finance on operational reconciliation and settlement issues

8\. MIS, Analytics \& Operational Governance

Establish a reliable Operations Control \& Reporting framework covering:

Policy volumes

SLA/TAT

Pending cases and ageing

Error/quality rates

Productivity

Insurer/portal performance

Dealer/region performance

Escalations

Root\-cause trends

Automation effectiveness

Operational exceptions  
Strong Excel / Power BI / SQL / analytical capability will be an advantage.

**Key Success Metrics**  
The candidate will be measured on measurable business outcomes, including:

* SLA/TAT adherence
* Policy issuance accuracy
* Endorsement \& cancellation TAT
* Pending\-case ageing
* Escalation resolution time
* Team productivity
* Dealer support SLA
* Insurer/partner issue resolution
* Operational error rate
* Automation\-enabled processing efficiency
* Reduction in manual intervention
* Process improvement and cost efficiency

What We're Looking For

**Must Have**

**5–8 years of experience in Motor/General Insurance Operations.**

* **Strong hands\-on experience in policy issuance and servicing**
* **Good understanding of endorsements, cancellations, renewals, corrections and break\-in cases**
* **Proven experience managing SLA/TAT and high\-volume operations**
* **2–3\+ years of team\-handling/L2 management experience**
* **Experience coordinating with multiple insurers/insurance partners**
* **Strong escalation and stakeholder\-management skills**
* **Strong Excel/MIS and analytical capability**
* **Ability to identify operational bottlenecks and drive RCA/corrective action**
* **Ability to work in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment**

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹900,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Sr Test Engineer - Automation (Selenium + Java + Playwright +AI Testing)
description:
**About Gartner IT:**  

Join a world\-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting\-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome\-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.
  

  

**About the role:**  

Gartner is looking for a well\-rounded and motivated test engineer to join its agile, scrum\-based Sales and Services technology team which is responsible for testing web, agentic and API applications and integrations to support its continuous delivery. You will contribute to maintenance and development of test automation frameworks and leverage AI tools for testing deliverables. This role requires technical skills and a collaborative approach in a fast\-paced Agile environment
  

  

**What you will do:**

* Develop and maintain quality assurance plans, test data, procedures, and scripts.
* Ability to execute functional testing along with an ability to identify opportunities for automation and create scripts. Design, build, and maintain effective test automation solutions which meet requirements and specifications. (Smoke, Functional, Regression, etc.)
* Leverage AI\-driven tools and techniques to strengthen both manual and automated testing workflows — including AI\-assisted test case generation, intelligent test execution, and automated result and support the validation of internally built AI agents
* Exposure to web technologies
* Ensure accurate and complete converges of designated test areas.
* Write effective manual/automated test scripts within the framework of approved testing tools using documented requirements and technical specifications provided by project team
* Provide test status, document defects and potential risks
* Effectively document defects using automated defect tracking software.
* Understand new product requirements and coordinate work across multiple project phases or complex assignments.
* Demonstrate attention to detail and the ability to balance quality, timelines, and resource constraints to deliver high\-quality products.

**What you will need :**  

Strong IT professional with 4\-6 yrs of experience in testing applications via both manual and automated tests. The candidate should have strong qualitative and quantitative problem\-solving skills along with high level of ownership and accountability. Ability to work in a collaborative team environment with good interpersonal skills.
  

  

**Must have:**

* 4\-6 years’ experience in an IT or Business environment testing highly scalable applications with significant experience designing automation platforms and writing automated tests
* **Proficiency in automating web applications across platforms using test automation tools and frameworks, including Selenium, TestNG, Playwright and/or Pytest test framework.**
* **Experience with API testing tools (e.g., Postman, Jmeter), including an ability to customize the code for load test creation.**
* **Well\-versed in Java/Git Source control.**
* **Experience in writing SQL queries, procedures, and function.**
* **Knowledge of Salesforce platform and database validation using SOQL**
* Hands on experience testing web services
* **Strong exposure to AI\-driven or agentic testing approaches leveraging multiple AI models**
* Expertise in QA prompt engineering, including designing and optimizing prompts to effectively drive AI agents for test generation, execution, and validation
* Able to independently support projects and work with various stakeholders

**What you are:**

* Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science or a related field required
* Excellent communication and prioritization skills.
* Able to work independently or within a team proactively in a fast\-paced AGILE\-SCRUM environment.
* Owns success – Takes responsibility for successful delivery of the solutions.
* Strong desire to improve upon their skills in software testing and technologies

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.

title: Senior Solutions Architect, Networking and Compute Infrastructure
description:
NVIDIA is looking for Senior Solution Architect, Networking and compute Infrastructure to join its NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialist Team. Academic and commercial groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to revolutionize deep learning and data analytics, and to power data centres. Join the team building many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world! We are looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills. This role will be interacting with customers, partners and internal teams, to analyse, define and implement large scale Networking projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of Networking, System Design and Automation and being the face to the customer!  

  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Primary responsibilities will include building AI/HPC infrastructure for new and existing customers.
* Support operational and reliability aspects of large\-scale AI clusters, focusing on performance at scale, real\-time monitoring, logging, and alerting.
* Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and refinement.
* Develop tooling to automate and manage of large\-scale infrastructure environments, to automate operational monitoring and alerting, and to enable self\-service consumption of resources.
* Deploy monitoring solutions for the servers, network and storage.
* Perform troubleshooting bottom up from bare metal, operating system, software stack and application level.
* Being a technical resource, develop, re\-define and document standard methodologies to share with customer and internal teams Support activities and engage in POCs/POVs for future improvements.
* Experience with system administration on Linux systems required (CentOS, RHEL, and Ubuntu preferred)

**What We Need to See:**

* BS/MS/PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, other Engineering fields with at least 5\+ years’ work or research experience in networking fundamentals, TCP/IP stack, and data centre compute architecture.
* Advance knowledge of HPC, AI \& EVPN, BGP, OSPF, VXLAN protocols.
* Deep understanding of DC architecture fundamentals such as compute, storage (PFS) \& InfiniBand, Ethernet, NVLink.
* Experience running HPC performance benchmarks, cluster health checks, and profiling tools to identify infrastructure bottlenecks.
* Python programming, bash scripting experience and Advance Linux knowledge.
* Extensive experience delivering automated network provisioning and comfortable with automation and configuration management tools including Jenkins, Ansible, Puppet. Chef, etc.
* Possess solid working knowledge of Ethernet/InfiniBand/RDMA core principles.
* Excellent customer\-facing and communication skills (verbal and written in both languages), enabling effective engagement with customers, partners, and cross\-functional teams across the India region. Listening skills in English are critical.
* Willingness to travel

**Ways To Stand Out from The Crowd:**

* Knowledge of CPU and/or GPU architecture including of Kubernetes, container related microservice technologies.
* Background with RDMA (InfiniBand or RoCE) fabrics.
* Linux or Networking Certifications (e.g., CCNP, CCIE) or NVIDIA\-related certifications.
* Deep Knowledge on observability stack and build experience.

At Guardian, we do not use AI Tools to substantially assist or replace human judgment or discretionary decision making in our hiring process. All hiring decisions will be made by Guardian colleagues.

  

Please be aware that if you apply for a specific position with Guardian, you will have the choice of opting out of Guardian’s use of AI Tools during the job application process. If you would like to request an alternative process that does not utilize AI Tools or would like to request a reasonable accommodation, within ten business days of your position application, you must email your request to MyHR@glic.com, making sure to provide your name and job requisition identification number. Guardian will retain your applicant materials and resume and all information therefrom in accordance with Guardian’s document retention policy, a copy of which you may request via MyHR@glic.com.

  

Additionally, at applicable times, Guardian will make public the most recent bias audit results for such AI tools, which may be found here.

title: QE Manager
description:
About This Role
**6 years of experience**  

**Skills: Selenium, Playwright, Java / Python, REST API Testing, BDD / Cucumber, JUnit / Mockito, CI/CD, Postman / RestAssured, Performance Testing, Git, SQL, Agile, Shift\-Left Testing, Defect Management, JIRA**

**About the Role**
  

We are looking for an experienced Quality Engineer with 6\+ years of experience to design, build, and execute automated test solutions across enterprise applications. You will bring strong test automation skills combined with solid domain knowledge — embedding quality as a first\-class concern across Agile delivery teams. This is a hands\-on technical QE role requiring strong coding ability, deep automation framework expertise, and a shift\-left quality mindset.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks covering UI, API, integration, and E2E testing layers.
* Develop automation scripts using Selenium WebDriver or Playwright supporting functional, regression, and cross\-browser testing.
* Build and maintain REST API test automation suites using RestAssured, Karate, or Postman covering API contracts and business logic validation.
* Write unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito collaborating with developers to improve code testability and test coverage.
* Build and maintain BDD test frameworks using Cucumber and Gherkin working with product owners and BAs to define business\-readable acceptance criteria.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines implementing quality gates that prevent defective code from reaching production.
* Champion shift\-left testing practices engaging with developers and architects early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Design and execute performance and load tests using JMeter or Gatling validating application scalability under realistic load conditions.
* Manage defect triage and reporting logging, prioritising, and tracking defects in Jira with clear business impact assessment.
* Mentor and coach junior QE team members sharing automation expertise across the team.

**What We're Looking For**


* 6\+ years of quality engineering experience with strong hands\-on technical automation expertise.
* Strong automation skills using Selenium WebDriver or Playwright building scalable, maintainable frameworks from scratch.
* Solid Java or Python skills writing production\-quality test automation code.
* Proven REST API testing expertise using RestAssured, Karate, or Postman.
* Experience with BDD frameworks including Cucumber and Gherkin for business\-readable test scenario automation.
* Strong CI/CD integration experience embedding quality gates into Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions pipelines.
* Good SQL skills for data validation and reconciliation testing.
* Strong shift\-left testing mindset engaging early in the delivery lifecycle to define testability and quality requirements.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills working effectively across developers, product owners, and DevOps teams.

**Nice to Have**


* Performance and load testing experience using JMeter, Gatling, or k6\.
* Contract testing experience using Pact or Spring Cloud Contract.
* Accessibility testing knowledge including WCAG standards and Axe tools.
* AI assisted testing tools including Mabl, Testim, or Applitools.
* ISTQB Foundation or Advanced certification.
* Experience in Financial Services, Banking, or regulated industry environments.

title: Senior Specialist, Product Management – Operational Intelligence Commercialisation
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Specialist, Product Management – Operational Intelligence Commercialisation
Job Description Summary  

Overview  

This Senior Specialist role in Product Management will support the commercialisation and sales expansion of Operational Reports across one of the five global regions. The role will focus on driving product adoption, identifying customer pain points, supporting sales enablement, and contributing to the development of commercialization strategies. The individual will work closely with regional ACS teams and the Global Product Management team to ensure alignment between product capabilities and market needs.  

Key Responsibilities  

Collaborate with ACS teams to support product commercialisation efforts and drive customer engagement  

Assist in identifying short\-term and long\-term whitespace opportunities and new use cases based on customer feedback and market trends  

Support internal and external partnership initiatives to accelerate go\-to\-market efforts  

Contribute to pricing strategy discussions and help quantify product value for customers  

Monitor product adoption and usage metrics, and support initiatives to improve customer engagement  

Assist in developing KPIs and tools to track commercialization success  

Contribute to the creation of region\-specific commercial constructs and go\-to\-market strategies  

Develop customer value narratives and case studies to support sales conversations  

Partner with regional teams to create and deliver sales training materials  

Build strong working relationships across cross\-functional teams to support commercialization goals  

All About You  

2\+ years of product management experience with a focus on go\-to\-market, pricing, and commercialisation in technology or data\-driven solutions; experience in payments or financial services is preferred. Experience in Python and SQL is preferred.  

Strong customer orientation and commercial acumen  

Exposure to API and AI\-based product commercialization is a plus  

Ability to support strategic product initiatives and contribute to business transformation  

Analytical mindset with a focus on solving customer problems and supporting sales efforts  

Understanding of competitive landscape and industry trends  

Experience working in cross\-functional teams and managing multiple priorities  

Bachelor’s degree in business or related field; MBA or equivalent experience is a plus  

Prior experience in strategy consulting or product commercialization is beneficial  

Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Manager SIOP Planning
description:
### **Role Responsibilities:**


* Own digital product strategy, roadmap, governance, adoption, and value realization for supply chain planning capabilities, including enterprise planning and supply chain technology platforms.
* Partner with SIOP, Manufacturing, Materials, Operations, and Digital stakeholders to align business priorities with technology investments and supply chain capability development.
* Lead end\-to\-end supply chain process transformation across Made\-to\-Stock (MTS), Made\-to\-Order (MTO), and Engineer\-to\-Order (ETO) business \& operating models, driving standardization, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct business process and solution architecture assessments to identify opportunities that improve service, inventory performance, productivity, and operational effectiveness across the value chain.
* Develop inventory optimization strategies, including MEIO (Multi\-Echelon Inventory Optimization), inventory segmentation, safety stock policies, and replenishment methodologies.
* Translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions through collaboration with technology and development teams, leveraging automation, advanced analytics, and AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Lead cross\-functional transformation programs and strategic initiatives, ensuring stakeholder alignment, execution discipline, and achievement of business outcomes.
* Drive complexity reduction initiatives, including SKU rationalization, portfolio optimization, planning parameter governance, and supply chain simplification efforts.
* Develop KPI frameworks, dashboards, analytics, business cases, and benefit\-tracking methodologies that support executive decision\-making and value realization.
* Partner with Master Data Management teams to improve data quality, governance, and accessibility across planning and operational systems.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to business and digital leadership by providing strategic recommendations, identifying transformation opportunities, and helping define long\-term business and technology priorities

### **Role Purpose**


* As the Senior Manager, SIOP Digital Partner — Enterprise Planning and Digital Transformation, you will shape and lead Carrier's supply chain planning capability strategy, driving digital transformation across planning, procurement, inventory, and fulfillment operations. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy and technology execution — translating complex supply chain requirements into scalable digital solutions that improve service, reduce cost, and enable competitive advantage across Carrier's global factory network.

### **Minimum Requirements**


* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Information Systems, Operations, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in supply chain planning, operations, digital transformation, program management, or related disciplines.
* Strong understanding of SIOP/IBP, demand planning, supply planning, inventory management, and manufacturing processes.
* Experience leading cross\-functional business transformation and technology initiatives.
* Experience with enterprise planning and ERP platforms (e.g., Kinaxis, SAP, or similar solutions).
* Ability to translate business requirements into technology\-enabled solutions and drive adoption across stakeholder groups.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and executive presentation skills.
* Proven ability to influence stakeholders and lead initiatives across business, operations, and technology organizations.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* MBA or advanced degree in a related field.
* Fluency in Mandarin will be preferred
* Experience with Kinaxis, KetteQ, LeanDNA, SAP ECC, and/or SAP S/4HANA.
* Experience with inventory optimization strategies, including MEIO, inventory segmentation, and safety stock methodologies.
* Knowledge of supply chain solution architecture, enterprise system integrations, APIs, master data governance, and data management principles.
* Experience leveraging advanced analytics, automation, AI/ML, or decision intelligence solutions.
* Experience supporting MTS, MTO, and ETO manufacturing environments.
* APICS/ASCM, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or similar professional certification.
